golden_rules: No Indian law enforcement agency (CBI, ED, Police, Customs, NIA, Narcotics Control Bureau) ever conducts arrests, searches, or formal interrogations over Skype, WhatsApp, or video calls.
The concept of 'Digital Arrest' is completely fictitious and does NOT exist in Indian law (CrPC / Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita). Any claim of digital arrest is 100% a scam.
TRAI (Telecom Regulatory Authority of India) and DoT never call citizens to say 'your mobile number will be disconnected in 2 hours' or demand money or Aadhaar verification over the phone.
No Indian bank, official department, or tax authority will ever ask for OTP, UPI PIN, ATM PIN, or CVV. UPI PIN is used ONLY to send/deduct money, NEVER to receive money or refunds.

Police, Court, or CBI notices are never served via personal WhatsApp numbers (+91-9... or international numbers like +92, +880, +1). Official correspondence comes via registered post, official police email (.gov.in), or formal in-person summons.

Electricity departments do not disconnect power connections on the same day via SMS links; state electricity boards send official bill notices with consumer numbers through official SMS headers (e.g., AD-MSEB, VM-BESCOM), never personal phone numbers.
Government subsidies (PM Kisan, Ladli Behna, PMAY, free laptops, etc.) are never delivered via APK downloads or WhatsApp links with url shorteners.

E-Challan payment notices from Traffic Police are hosted exclusively on https://echallan.parivahan.gov.in or official state police portals. Fake challan messages link to look-alike URLs or APK downloads.
No genuine authority will demand money transfer to 'clear your name' in a money laundering case or 'verify your funds in a RBI verification account'.

digital_arrest.name: Digital Arrest / Law Enforcement Impersonation
tactics: Threatening arrest for parcel containing illegal drugs, fake passports, or money laundering
Video call in fake police station setup with uniform
Demanding money transfer into 'RBI security account' to clear charges
Forged CBI, Mumbai/Delhi Police, Supreme Court or Interpol arrest warrants

trai_sim_block.name: TRAI / DoT Telecom Disconnection Scam
tactics: Automated IVR call stating phone number will be terminated within 2 hours
Asking to press 9 to speak with an executive
Claiming number was used in harassing messages or financial fraud

fake_kyc_bank.name: Bank / Wallet KYC Expiry Scam
tactics: SMS threatening account suspension if KYC is not updated today
Links to phishing forms mimicking SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB or Paytm
Demanding installation of AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or QuickSupport to 'assist'

electricity_bill.name: Electricity / Utility Bill Disconnection Scam
tactics: SMS: 'Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM because previous month bill was not updated'
Provides an unverified mobile number to contact the 'electricity officer'

fake_challan.name: Fake Traffic E-Challan APK Scam
tactics: SMS claiming a pending traffic fine with vehicle number
Direct link to download a malicious .apk file named Parivahan_challan.apk

lottery_job_scheme.name: Work from Home / Part-Time Telegram Task / PM Scheme Scam
tactics: Telegram group offering daily income for YouTube likes, hotel reviews
Fake PM Kisan 17th installment disbursement link
Initial small payout followed by large deposits that can never be withdrawn
